title: STUNNING VIEWS, LUXURY, LOCATION
description:
Perched high on a hill with breathtaking 10 mile views from every room. 800 square feet. 

Luxuriously furnished as shown, includes everything from linens and towels to silverware.

Two master suites, (Each with en-suite bathroom) are located on opposite ends of the home. (Available for a six month lease)

The space
Perched high on a hill with breathtaking 10 mile views from every room.

Luxuriously furnished as shown, includes everything from linens and towels to silverware.

This ground floor Green Hills condominium even has its own small yard just off the large private slate patio. 

Large slate patio is perfect for entertaining or relaxing, with ceiling fans, fire pit and automatic low voltage lighting.

The property has a tennis court, pool, & private hillside hiking trails.

Less than 1/2 a mile down the hill is the Bluebird Café, Whole Foods, Nordstrom, Tiffany, and other exclusive shops, restaurants and entertainment.

Guest access
The entire condo of course, and all of the amenities on the property available to other residents.
